initiatives.demandNote: Long-range accessibility signal across established and emerging districts; station catchments matter more than generic corridor proximity.
initiatives.supplyRiskNote: Not yet construction-stage; property narrative risk if timelines slip from 2026 tender / 2027 award / 2032 opening path.

initiatives.marketImpact: Strengthens the events economy around Dubai South and Expo City, with demand effects tied to phased operating capacity.
initiatives.coordinateBasis: Emirate-level strategy marker — not a surveyed project-site coordinate
initiatives.accessibilityNote: Anchored at Expo City / Dubai South; Phase 2 adds Eastern Access Road, extended concourse and multi-storey parking (~7,000 spaces initially).
initiatives.demandNote: Strengthens the events economy around Dubai South and Expo City; demand effects track phased operating capacity rather than the full 2031 masterplan.
initiatives.supplyRiskNote: Hospitality and residential spillover depends on event calendar utilisation; later phases (2028/2031) remain delivery targets.
initiatives.researchNotes: Updated to note Phase 1 completed/operating early 2026 (WAM 9 Sep 2026); Phase 2 ~2028 and final ~2031 retained from DWTC masterplan.
